title: Data and code for: Spatiotemporal patterns and environmental drivers of tropical forest biodiversity dynamics in the subtropical Atlantic Forest
description:
Reproducibility package (data, R and Google Earth Engine scripts, results, and supplementary material) for the manuscript Spatiotemporal patterns and environmental drivers of tropical forest biodiversity dynamics in the subtropical Atlantic Forest.

The project evaluates temporal forest reorganization in Santa Catarina, southern Brazil, using permanent sampling units of the SinFlor/FlorestaSC forest inventory measured in two cycles (2007–2010 and 2014–2020). The workflow integrates taxonomic turnover, demographic change, environmental predictors, phylogenetic diversity, phylogenetic signal, null models, ordination, db-RDA, variance partitioning, and spatial interpolation. See README.md for the repository structure and analytical workflow.

Restricted data: forest inventory species-by-plot matrices and sampling-unit coordinates are not included and must be requested from SinFlor (https://www.sinflor.com.br/; see README.md).

Licensing: data, results, and documentation are under CC BY 4.0; source code in scripts/ is under the MIT License.
